items.prompt: Why explicitly exclude bool from UnsignedAmount?

options.text: Every concept automatically excludes logical types
options.why: The actual predicate must be inspected.

options.text: The standard unsigned_integral concept can accept bool
options.why: The narrower amount interface deliberately rejects it.

options.text: Excluding bool makes account units automatically correct

items.explanation: A concept name does not replace reading its exact definition; the explicit exclusion is part of this own API contract.
